channel.title: Josh Stepakoff Real Estate Blog
channel.description: San Fernando Valley real estate, explained by a local Realtor. Market updates, neighborhood guides, and practical advice for Porter Ranch, Northridge, Granada Hills, Chatsworth, and beyond.

item.title: Your LA County Property Tax Bill: A Plain-English Guide for Valley Homeowners
item.description: Property tax bills are out and the first payment is due. Here is how your LA County bill works, the key deadlines, and the savings Valley homeowners often miss.

item.title: Should You Sell Your Porter Ranch Home Now or Wait?
item.description: It is the question I keep hearing from Porter Ranch homeowners, and searches for it are way up. Here are the local numbers that matter: median price, days on market, sale-to-list ratio, mortgage rates, and my honest take on selling now versus waiting.

item.title: Porter Ranch Real Estate Market Update: September 2026
item.description: September 2026 single-family numbers for Porter Ranch (91326): a $1.2M median sale price, more inventory, and homes taking a bit longer to sell. Here is what it means.

item.title: What Is My Home Worth? How a Valley Realtor Actually Prices a Home
item.description: Online estimates are a starting point, not an answer. Here is the comp-based method I use to value homes in Porter Ranch and across the San Fernando Valley, and what I look at to land on the price your home will actually sell for.
